from collections import defaultdict
import re

pwds = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
creds = {p['account_name']: p['password'] for p in pwds}

phone_access = apis.phone.login(username='2254213734', password=creds['phone'])['access_token']
gmail_access = apis.gmail.login(username='jo-harr@gmail.com', password=creds['gmail'])['access_token']
spotify_access = apis.spotify.login(username='jo-harr@gmail.com', password=creds['spotify'])['access_token']

print('tokens ok', bool(phone_access), bool(gmail_access), bool(spotify_access))

# Fetch all phone contacts to use as canonical friend set (phone numbers)
contacts = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    res = apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_access, query='', page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not res:
        break
    contacts.extend(res)
    page_index += 1
print('contacts fetched', len(contacts))
phone_numbers = set([c['phone_number'] for c in contacts if c.get('phone_number')])
print('sample phone numbers', list(phone_numbers)[:10])

JO_PHONE='2254213734'

# Search text messages that likely contain artist recommendations
queries = [
    'favorite artists',
    'Here are some of my favorite artists',
    'favorite artist',
    'Here are some',
    'favorite'
]

all_msgs = []
for q in queries:
    page_index=0
    while True:
        msgs = apis.phone.search_text_messages(access_token=phone_access, query=q, phone_number=None, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20, sort_by=None)
        if not msgs:
            break
        all_msgs.extend(msgs)
        page_index += 1
    print('done query', q)

# Deduplicate by text_message_id
msg_map = {m['text_message_id']: m for m in all_msgs}
msgs = list(msg_map.values())
print('total unique text messages found', len(msgs))

# Filter to messages received by Jordan that contain a favorites-artist list
pattern = re.compile(r"favorite artists\s*,?\s*(.+)$", re.IGNORECASE|re.DOTALL)

recommendations=[]
for m in msgs:
    if str(m['receiver']['phone_number']) != JO_PHONE:
        continue
    text = (m.get('message') or '')
    if 'favorite artists' not in text.lower() and 'favorite artist' not in text.lower():
        continue
    match = pattern.search(text.strip())
    if not match:
        # Sometimes list may come after comma after phrase; try relaxed
        continue
    tail = match.group(1).strip()
    # Remove trailing punctuation
    tail = re.sub(r'[\n\r]+', ' ', tail)
    # If there are extra sentences, keep first sentence fragment
    tail = tail.split('.')[0]
    # Split by commas
    parts = [p.strip() for p in tail.split(',')]
    parts = [p for p in parts if p]
    for artist in parts:
        recommendations.append({
            'artist_name': artist,
            'from_name': m['sender'].get('name'),
            'from_phone': m['sender'].get('phone_number'),
            'text_message_id': m['text_message_id'],
            'source_text': text
        })

print('phone recommendation pairs', len(recommendations))

# Keep only from known contacts (if sender phone number exists)
filtered_recs=[]
for r in recommendations:
    fp = r.get('from_phone')
    if fp and fp in phone_numbers:
        filtered_recs.append(r)

print('after contact filter', len(filtered_recs))

# Deduplicate artists (keeping one representative per artist)
rep_by_artist={}
for r in filtered_recs:
    name_key = r['artist_name'].strip()
    if name_key not in rep_by_artist:
        rep_by_artist[name_key]=r

phone_artists = sorted(rep_by_artist.keys())
print('phone artists', phone_artists)

print('verification table:')
for a in phone_artists:
    r=rep_by_artist[a]
    print(a,'| from',r['from_name'],f"({r['from_phone']})",'| msg_id',r['text_message_id'])
